independentReview.notes: Before the fix, the authenticated or temporary-session menu could reveal the /access/ button without any listener. access.js had no logout listener; the shared module only attached to elements marked data-private-logout. /access/manage and /admin have their own listeners and /config creates a shared handled button. The existing boundary gate previously covered only the created-button path; this PR added the static-button path.
